conversion: 48 kHz stereo PCM16; per-file peak staging with -7 dB instrument headroom. 44.1 kHz sources use deterministic linear resampling.
limitations: Concert Harp xfin/xfout crossfades are represented as a hard velocity split at 70 because the current engine has no SFZ crossfade opcode.
Native envelope and velocity response, not a claim of bit-exact SFZ emulation.
